title: PartiCam: Camera Controlled Video Generation with Reward Guidance
abstract: We present PartiCam, a training-free Particle filtering rooted method for improved Camera controlled video generation. Generating videos that follow a precisely specified camera trajectory remains challenging for large video diffusion models. Training-free approaches are backbone-agnostic and avoid the need to construct large camera-annotated datasets by steering pretrained models toward the desired camera motion at test time. This enables the generation of camera-controlled video data that can subsequently be used to train camera-conditioned video diffusion models. Existing sampling-based guidance approaches often suffer from unstable trajectories: they either explore too broadly and fail to respect the target camera motion or collapse early and lose visual diversity over time. We introduce a global-local refinement framework for diffusion reward guidance, enabling accurate and consistent camera control during video generation. Our method builds on Sequential Monte-Carlo (SMC) guidance, but introduces a local refinement stage based on particle filtered resampling. Experiments show large improvements in camera trajectory adherence, reduced drift, and better visual quality, without requiring model retraining.

analysis.ideaZh: PartiCam 把 globalSMC aesthetic 重采样与 localcamera-reward noising/denoising restarts 结合，可不用 rewardgradient 改进 videoreshooting。作者报告同 CogVideo ATE.981→.807、FID41.08→31.86；SVD rotation 反差.400→.489，trainedTrajectoryCrafter FID29.86→30.01。可速读几何控制 reward 组合；9static+9dynamic 场景、reward 参数与实际 compute 未齐，不能称所有 backbones 更好、更快或精确 posterior sampler。
analysis.motivationZh: 相机控制的视频仍可能偏离目标路径，单条采样轨迹也容易兼顾不了画质。目标是结合全局探索和局部 camera reward，选择更合适的生成轨迹。
analysis.methodZh: 以 NVS-Solver warped-view scoremodulation 为基线，维护 K2global trajectories；早期 decodedTweedie samples 按 aestheticpotential 差更新 weights/ESSresample。每 particle 在 selectedsteps 生成 Nr2localperturbations，用 VGGT camera-errorreward 选 continuation，重复 4 次。global 负责探索、local 修 camera drift，不需要训练 head 或 backpropthroughreward；实验证明部分 camera-control 任务改善，输出仍 video 而非 explicit3Dscene，reward-model 错误和有限 population 会限制效果。
methodFlow: inputimage 或 monocularvideo 与 targetcamera path，以 NVS-Solver scoremodulation 约束 videodiffusion
K2particles 常规 reversepropagate，Tweedie 解码中间 candidate 算 aestheticreward
每四 iterations 用 potentialratio 累积 globalweights，ESS 低时 resample
iterations8–32 每 particle 两 localnoise-denoiseproposals，以 VGGTcamera reward 随机 resample，local 循环 4 次
global 指导持续至 iteration40，完成 100iterationgeneration，ParticleSFM 独立估 camera 供评价

analysis.insightZh: 将 globalpopulationselection 和 localreward-filteredrestart 组合用于 camerareshooting 是可复用 sampling 控制，非新 foundation model。SMC/restarts/scoremodulation 已有，贡献主要 task-awareglobal/local 分工与实验；局部 biasedselection 后未给充分 proposalcorrection 证明，按 heuristic rewardguidance 理解，不声称精确 twistedposterior。

analysis.caveatZh:
multipletrajectories 可能需更大 denoisingbudget，quality/control 优先下 tradeoff。
reward 设计和 task-specifictuning 影响效果。
localreward-resampling 改变 proposal 后 weightunchanged 是近似 heuristic，不能按 formalexactSMC 采样保证。
VGGTpose 奖励和 ParticleSFM 评价都依赖可匹配静态 features，dynamic/occlusion/failedpose 比例未报。
mainTable2 基线与 oursbackbone 不同，应以 Table3matchedpair 为效果大小依据。
no-gradreward 省反传不等于更少 forward，未给 actualtiming 支持 speedclaim 或 higherdiversitymeasure。
100steps/twoparticles/4localrepeat 开销非 trivial，K/Nr 提高不单调，模型/scene 依赖。
输出 camera 估计更接近 target 不证明 occludedgeometry 真实性、physicaldynamics 或 persistent3Dasset。
